question: Can a local validation set be chosen whose scores track the platform's 322-row scores?

task_a.description: unstructured per-row weights on the 322 query rows fitted to the 23 registered platform deltas

task_b.description: row weights restricted to a small a-priori basis (level, spout, prediction quintile)

task_c.description: 322-row subsets of the recorded OOF rows, level-matched to the platform score, versus the candidate's platform verdict

limits: Task A and B fit unknown residual-sign weights from 23 registered outcomes; a low training error is guaranteed and is not evidence of identifiability.
Task C subsets reuse rows that the base models saw in other folds, so they are not independent holdouts; the experiment measures level sensitivity only.
No platform score is forecast, no history is rewritten and no family is closed by this review.
